newsitem.title: USA: Republicans retain control of U.S. Senate.
newsitem.headline: Republicans retain control of U.S. Senate.

text.p: Republicans kept control of the U.S. Senate after winning 16 of the 34 Senate races to give them a 51-seat majority, according to projected election returns on Tuesday.

Republicans held 35 of the Senate seats not up for election this year. Key victories were shifts to Republican control in two states, Arkansas and Alabama, which had been held by retiring Democrats. Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott, a Mississippi Republican, said on CNN: "It looks like I will be majority leader of the Senate."
